svg.aria-label: Left: endpoint RMSE against each model’s own reference. Middle: 32-direction sliced W1 against the same held-out set. Circles,squares,triangles indicate Euler,Heun,RK4; x measures network evaluations. Right: mean path length minus chord across 1,024 reference trajectories.
